findings.body: The result value union has no field capable of carrying the available-only Budget subtotal required when some selected Plant/months have Budget and others do not. With mixed coverage, the schema permits only a null `budget: not_loaded` and therefore discards the exact Budget from covered coordinates. This prevents D8 and range/YTD answers from satisfying the confirmed requirement in `docs/specs/langgraph-financial-chat.md:134-137`. Add a distinct partial-Budget value and positive/negative mixed-coverage tests, while keeping complete Budget and percentage unavailable.
findings.title: Not done: partial Budget answers retain an exact labelled available subtotal

findings.body: The continuation negative control is hollow: it changes the fixture to page 2 with 21 total items but retains only the original single transaction. Parsing therefore throws from the transaction-count check even if the pinned-limit guard is removed. Likewise, the preceding totalPages case still has the wrong page-1 row count, so it would throw if the totalPages formula broke. Add valid multi-page fixtures that isolate the 10-row prepared page, page-2 offset, pinned limit, size-change rejection, and totalPages formula.
findings.title: Not done: transaction pagination validation

findings.body: `financialSelectionSchema` accepts duplicate `plantIds`, although `financialQueryResultSchema` later rejects any result whose embedded selection contains duplicates. Thus an input such as `["DUB", "DUB"]` passes the strict `query_financials` input schema but no corresponding output can pass validation. Enforce uniqueness in the selection schema and cover it in the selection-validation test.
findings.title: Reject duplicate Plants at the selection boundary

findings.body: The result refinement checks only that requested value keys are present; it never rejects additional known measure keys. For example, an Actual-only selection can validate rows and totals containing Budget, Roll-over, or percentage values as long as their coverage states are internally consistent. This defeats the claimed strict selection/result boundary and allows server mistakes to return financial data outside the confirmed selection. Require each value set to equal the selected measures plus explicitly requested derived comparison fields.
findings.title: Reject unrequested financial values in validated results
